english_classification.chapter_title: [C]oncerning the Father of Gr[eat]ness: [ho]w he is established and determined.
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter is almost entirely oldest-layer substrate. It presents a systematic five-fold emanation teaching: the Father of Greatness established in his five light limbs (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration = the storehouses), his twelve wisdoms, and the five great springs that gush forth from him (light, perfume, living voice, [lacuna], glory). Both sides of every mapping remain within the cosmic system. There is zero editorial bridge, institutional, or exhortation vocabulary. The only non-substrate material is the formulaic dialogue opening (¶1) and a minor audience reference in ¶2. Heavy lacunae throughout, especially in ¶¶7-8, but the five-fold enumeration structure is clear. Teaching purity 1.000 confirms the dominance of the oldest layer.
